description: Every published v2 mailbox. PUBLIC rows carry {address, metaAddress, kemPub}; PRIVATE rows (the default since 2026-08-28) carry {handle, metaAddress, kemPub} and deliberately NO address. Identical for every reader, so fetching it reveals nothing about whom you intend to message — pick the recipient locally. Seal with the SDK: seal({metaAddress, kemPub}, {text, ts, from?, sig?}). Read-only.
name: robyn_message_directory
title: Messaging v2 — all mailboxes (oblivious lookup)
